text: Paul Watkins is a team member of the World of Warcraft team.
Paul Burges is a human located in Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.
Peon Bolgar is an orc trade goods vendor located at Spinebreaker Post in the Hellfire Peninsula.

Peratryn (real name unknown) is a member of Blizzard Entertainment's Web & Mobile Team. Peratryn posts in the Community Platform API forums. At some point, Peratryn's title was changed to Battle.net Developer.

Pepe is a small bird that (most of the time) lives in the commander's garrison. Pepe can also be found out in the world of , and finding Pepe's four costumes is the objective of the achievement I Found Pepe!. Pepe can be accessed anywhere with Trans-Dimensional Bird Whistle, a reward from What A Strange, Interdimensional Trip It's Been.

Penelope Heathrow is a human girl located initially at Heathrow Manor in Val'sharah. She was not in the village when the attack on Bradensbrook by Black Rook Hold spirits began, and would later be found by the adventurer hiding in the manor's cellar. Once rescued, she took "a shortcut" back to the village.
Perek Tidesweeper is a human located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players. His mount uses the model for the Dim Coldflame Core.
Percy Vesser is a human located at the Old Drust Road north of Vigil Hill in Tiragarde Sound.
Peledormu is a bronze dragon located at the Ruby Life Pools in the Waking Shores.
Perfectly Balanced Glaive is a Vengeance demon hunter talent.

Peter Galen is a human artisan dragonscale leatherworking trainer located at a camp in the Ruins of Eldarath east of the Forlorn Ridge in Azshara. He taught Alliance leatherworkers the dragonscale leatherworking specialty. After patch 2.0.3, to unlearn Dragonscale Leatherworking, Peter would tell players to first go see Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris, just north of the Steamwheedle Port. Narain pointed you to the book on the table which would teach the player either Dragonscale, Elemental or Tribal leatherworking. Dragonscale specialization could also be learned with Peter, but it cost .
Petra Grossen was an orc that could be found in at Marshal's Refuge in Un'Goro Crater. She has been missing since the Cataclysm. Whether she died with her companion Dadanga is unclear.

Petopia is a World of Warcraft fansite, dedicated to hunter pets. Petopia was created by Bamoo, also known as [http://brashendeavors.net/ Brash Endeavors]. The site was then edited and maintained by a hunter named Mania for many years before the torch was passed on to Wain who also runs Warcraft Mounts. Wain has had Ranger Wain named after them at the Trueshot Lodge.

Petty Officer Chulok is an orc located at Hellscream's Grasp in the Tol Barad Peninsula. Should the Alliance control Tol Barad or a battle is in progress, you can turn in the quests given by Staff Sergeant Lazgar, Drillmaster Razgoth, Private Garnoth & Commander Zanoth to him.

Peter Hamelspot is a human who had been working for the Fallrooks-family for over thirty years when he witnessed Cedrick Fallrook killing his brother Erik. In due time he warned Marshal Redpath so Kerri Hicks could be freed. It is unknown what happened with him during and after the Forsaken invasion of Hillsbrad Foothills.
Peter Kearie is a human located at Lunarfall's Alchemy Lab. He accepts Frostweed work orders creating Alchemical Catalysts.
Peter Toulios is a human located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Perla Nightfang is a night elf druid located at the Dreamgrove.
Perry Charlton is a human located at Boralus Harbor in Boralus. He and Dockwarden Finnson are described as a shady couple.
Pettra was an orc whose scouting party was ambushed by the Warmaul ogres. He held on longer and was fed to boars aboard their vessel.
Perpetual Paralysis is a Level 22 Windwalker monk PvP talent.
Petunia Glimmerhoof is a tauren mage standing next to Ursyn Ghull in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.
Pernilla Wildpike is a dwarf found with a Tame Pack Goat in Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span.

Pharaoh Tebhotep was a tol'vir ruler. During his reign, a plague of serpents struck the Vir'naal River in central Uldum. Nothing could drive away the reptiles until a second plague of desert scarabs appeared. The scarabs and serpents fought until not a single one of either creature remained and peace returned to the land.
Pierce is an officer in Theramore's army, most likely a colonel as he is mentioned by Duree as the one who should be sent to Northwatch to investigate recent events rather than Colonel Lorena.
Philip O'Tool is a human weapon vendor located at the sea base of Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.

Pheary Sparkrocket is the Horde hunter leader of Ashran, found in Warspear Outpost. She patrols from the center of the Outpost along the ramp leading down into Warspear itself, with a Kaliri Skyterror pet at her side.
Phillip Hillenbrand is a human found in the Hero's Rest Inn in Stormshield.
Phillip was a boy in a Lordaeron's village. He announced Thomas Thomson that Baron Rivendare's supplies has arrived. Upon eating them, he became an undead and was put down by Thomas.
Phoenix Reborn is a Fire mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Everburning Consumption trait.
Phanthanhes Elune'alor is a night elf located at Sylvan Vale in Val'sharah.
Phil Greenoak is a night elf located at The Traveler's Den in Val'sharah.
Philip Stormwell is a human paladin of the Silver Hand located in Stratholme. He can be chosen to accompany the Highlord throughout the scenario during Stirring in the Shadows.
Phoe'be is an unknown woman whom Rachele and Roscoe have been waiting for at least an hour.
Philip Haribul is a human located at the Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.

Phillip Williams is a human located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus. He does maintenance work at Byron & Bros. Boralan B.B.Q. and occasionally drops by Maps, Scrolls & Mysteries to have a look at the maps on display there.
Piercing Fangs is a row 10 Beast Mastery hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Killer Cobra.
Pinning Glare was a Havoc demon hunter honor talent, available at rank 43.
Pippi is a human vendor located at the Stormwind Gate in Elwynn Forest.
Pilkigosa was a blue dragon who died during the Nexus War. Her name is on a Fresh Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Plunderbeard is a dwarf located in the Wintergarde Mausoleum in the Dragonblight.
Plip Fatpurse is a goblin general goods vendor located at K3 in Storm Peaks.
Pliar Nose Andy is a human located in Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.
Polearm Specialization is a warrior talent, located on tier 6 of the Arms tree.
Pogg is a level 85 orc the quartermaster for Hellscream's Reach located in Hellscream's Grasp in the Tol Barad Peninsula.

Po Longbrow was the son of the famous pandaren hunter Zhu Longbrow and his wife Rin. Together, Zhu, Rin and and Po carved out and settled a corner of the Krasarang Wilds in order to create safe passage to the coast, creating the Zhu Province and Zhu's Watch. Like his parents, Po was a formidable hunter in his own right. One of the three memorial bonfires which line the southwestern border of the Zhu Province and discourage beasts from wandering out of the wilds is named after him.
Poisonmaster Pollark is a night elf who works for . He is a poison master and a contracted apprentice of Myra Rotspring. She uses him to find the most lethal of substances.
Poison Injection is a row 10 hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Hydra's Bite.
Postmaster Malown is an elite human ghost mini-boss found in Stratholme.
Poranna Snowbraid is a dwarf tailoring vendor located at the Great Forge in Ironforge.
Polly Jo is a human located at Wayward Landing in the Jade Forest.
Portal Master Jorvinax is a fel lord located at the Peak of Serenity.
Polymorph Pam was a human located in Bridgeport in Tiragarde Sound. She lost her Wand of Polymorph to the Inland Clacksnappers in Winterdeep Basin just outside town.
Portalkeeper Cimbra is a night elf of the Primalists located in the Throughway in Zaralek Cavern. Before coming to the cavern, he trained in the Firelands.
Potent Kick is a Brewmaster monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Full Keg, Hot Blooded and Healthy Appetite traits.
Potionmaster Donovan is a human located at Andorhal in The Deaths of Chromie scenario.
Powdermaster Maclin is an skeletal orc planned to appear in Dead Man's Bay in Azsuna.
Pratt was a member Creedy's gang of bounty hunters. He was killed by Hemet Nesingwary when the bounty hunters where hunting three frostsaber cubs, that Hemet was protecting.
Prelate Enathae was a blood elf found at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.
Prayer Circle is a Holy priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Healing Chorus.

Priestess Josetta is a human priest and priest trainer located in the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest. She can be found in the upstairs section of the Lion's Pride Inn, in the central room along with Michelle Belle. She wished when she was younger she could have mustered the courage to travel the world.

Priestess Anetta is a human priest and priest trainer located in Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. She is a sacerdotal member of the Brotherhood of Northshire. She can be found on the ground floor of the abbey, in the library wing. One of her responsibilities at the abbey is to heal the wounded trainees that can be found throughout the abbey. She is notable for training novice priests the basics of wielding the Light.

Priestess Alorah is a high elf priestess that works for the Argent Crusade as part of the Argent Tournament. When the Twin Valkyr and their Vengeful Valkyr army appear to invade the Argent Tournament Grounds, Argent Confessor Paletress will come and battle the twins and win while Alorah and Priest Grimmin will arrive and focus on the bonds that keep the twins captured. Later she and Grimmin will despawn sometime after they have been captured.
Priestess Cocoa Anderson is a human priest trainer located at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.
Priestess Baerla is a dwarf priest trainer located in the town of Thelsamar in Loch Modan.
Priestess Laralla is a human member of the 7th Legion encountered in the Domination Point scenario.
Pridelord Karash was the leader of the Bloodmane saberon 600 years before the First War. He declared war upon the high arakkoa but was eventually slain by the arakkoan king, Terokk.
Priestess Llaenia is a night elf found at the night elven camp in Stormshield. She and Myshal Ravendancer are discussing the Ancient Artifact that Harrison Jones is searching for.
Primal Combatant's Desecration is the Warlords Season 1 Death knight arena set.
Primal Combatant's Satin is the Warlords Season 1 priest arena set.
Prideful Gladiator's Desecration is the Season 15 death knight arena set.
Prideful Gladiator's Pursuit is the Season 15 hunter arena set.
Prideful Gladiator's Regalia is the Season 15 mage arena set.
Prideful Gladiator's Ironskin is the Season 15 monk arena set.
Prideful Gladiator's Copperskin is the Season 15 monk arena set.
Prideful Gladiator's Investiture is the Season 15 priest arena set.
Prideful Gladiator's Raiment is the Season 15 priest arena set.
Priestess Lylliana is a night elf located in Mistvine Ledge in Zuldazar.
Primal Robe is the starting chest for draenei, dwarf, orc, tauren, and troll shaman.
Primal Gladiator's Battlegear is the epic Warlords Season 1 warrior arena set.
Primal Gladiator's Desecration is the epic Warlords Season 1 death knight arena set.
Primal Gladiator's Desecration is the epic Warlords Season 1 hunter arena set.
Primal Gladiator's Regalia is the epic Warlords Season 1 mage arena set.
Gladiator's Ironskin is the epic Warlords Season 1 monk arena set.
Primal Gladiator's Investiture is the epic Warlords Season 1 priest arena set.

Prince Malchezaar was a prince of the man'ari eredar and a demon of the Burning Legion. He took control of the tower of Karazhan where he can be fought as a raid boss, at the very top of the tower. Access to his room, the Netherspace, is granted after the Chess Event encounter. Warlocks wearing Deathrattle Regalia had a chance to summon Malchezaar "from the void" in Warlords of Draenor, prior to the deactivation of old tier set bonuses, who then assisted them in battle. Presently, a demonology warlock with the Nether Portal talent has a chance for Malchezaar to appear as one of the additional demons that have a chance of appearing.
Primitive Kilt is the starting legs for orc, tauren, and troll shaman.
Primitive Mantle is the starting shirt for orc, tauren, and troll shaman.
Prismatic Crystal is a level 100 mage talent. The crystal lasts for 12 sec. It summoned an object with the same name.

Commander Priscilla Hawes was a human who fought during the Second War. As a member of Kul Tiras, she was part of the marine army whose battles were all at sea. While on the Gale's Reprieve, she would die during the Battle of Crestfall when red dragons breath fire on their vessels, sending their ships to the bottom of the sea. In the present day, she is one of the Drowned Sailors.

Prince Erazmin is the son of King Mechagon, ruler of the Mechagon mechagnomes. When he learned of Mechagon's plans of mechanizing all organic life, Erazmin formed the Rustbolt Resistance, later aided by adventurers from the Alliance and the Horde, to stop his father's mad scheme. Following Mechagon's overthrow and the reunification of the mechagnomes with their flesh-and-blood kin from Gnomeregan, Erazmin now serves as counselor to the new king, Gelbin Mekkatorque.

Private Rocknot is a Dark Iron dwarf patron of the Grim Guzzler found in Blackrock Depths. Mistress Nagmara is in love with him. He is involved in two different methods of opening the bar's backdoor: *One way is to buy him six Dark Iron Ale Mugs. He will then look for more and cause a huge barrel to pop something like a cork at the door. This angers Phalanx who is the bar enforcer. *The other way is to help Mistress Nagmara create a love potion after which she and Rocknot will slip through the backdoor unnoticed by the other patrons.
Privateer Bloads is a human located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

Private Casey is a human warrior located at Death's Stand in the Borean Tundra. He is a member of Unit S. He may be the one of two who survived the suicide mission as mentioned in the Death Knight manga.
Private Hallan is a human who accompanied Lieutenant Caldwell to deal with Paval Reethe. She shot him but in turn, the whole Theramore group was killed by the Horde adventurer.
Privateer Stonemantle was the captain and sole crew member of The Frostbreaker, which brought Alliance players to battle in the Strand of the Ancients. She couldn't be killed.
Private Furlbrow is a member of the the Valiance Expedition and is currently stationed at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in the Grizzly Hills. He is the son of Theodore Furlbrow and Verna Furlbrow.

Private Merle was a rebel soldier in the Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale. He was secretly still loyal to Colonel Kurzen. He learned of Private Thorsen's mission to infiltrate Kurzen's Compound and gather intelligence and arranged to have him killed. However, Thorsen survived and the rebels soon learned of Merle's true allegiance. He spawned after completing Patrol Schedules, whereby you learn of his betrayal, and he runs out of the camp, vowing vengeance. He will either be killed by the camp guards or by some undead if he makes it to the edge of nearby Duskwood.
Private Reginald Pollard is a human survivor first found in an underwater cavern in Kelp'thar Forest. His counterpart is Gurrok. Pollard is part of the 13th brigade of the Storwmwind infantry.

Prisoner is a human being escorted from the Stormwind Harbor to the Stormwind Stockade by two guards. He wears a red bandanna, signifying that he is a member of the Defias Brotherhood, the apparent reason for his arrest.

Private Robert Anthony is a human located at Lion's Watch in Tanaan Jungle. He is a soldier in the Alliance military and is part of the force that is engaged against Gul'dan's Iron Horde in Tanaan. He can be found in the bunker at Lion's Watch known as the Lion's Den.
Private Jesse Long is a human found in the Hero's Rest Inn in Stormshield.
Private Denning was a soldier of Honor Hold who got killed by the Bleeding Hollow clan, his insignia now serving as a cursed talisman for them.

Private Guarding was a soldier of Honor Hold who got killed by the Bleeding Hollow clan, his insignia now serving as a cursed talisman for them. He always was quick to laugh until an orc tore out his throat.
Private Leonard is a human located in Vol'dun. He accompanied the Alliance army into the desert on the Wind's Redemption but died soon after an sethrak attack.

Prospector Gehn was a dwarf located in Gol'Bolar Quarry in the dwarven starting zone of Dun Morogh. He is affiliated with the Explorers' League. He was removed with the Cataclysm and in his place stands Prospector Drugan.

Prospector Gunstan is a dwarf located in the Valley of the Watchers in Tanaris. He is maintaining a lonely vigil over the gates of Uldum on behalf of the Explorers' League. With the Cataclysm exposing Uldum to the world, Gunstan is joined by fellow explorers at his new camp, Gunstan's Dig.
Protector Deni is a member of Westfall Brigade and is found standing just outside Sentinel Hill's mill. She was previously part of the People's Militia. She was present during the Legion Invasions.
Prospector Murantus is a dwarf found with a group of Explorers' League Archaeologists in Honor Hold of Hellfire Peninsula.
Prospector Belvar is a dwarf located at Fort Wildervar in the Howling Fjord.

Protector Dorana is a human guard at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. She patrols the road from Sentinel Hill to Saldean's Farm. She is affiliated with the Westfall Brigade. Dorana is subtlety known for killing the harvest watcher closest to the pathway at Saldean's Farm. She was previously part of the People's Militia. She was present during the Legion Invasions.

Protector Dutfield is a human guard in Sentinel Hill in Westfall. He patrols around the bottom of Sentinel Tower, but will occasionally stop to combat the gnolls, if they come too close to the tower. He is affiliated with the Westfall Brigade. He was previously part of the People's Militia. He was present during the Legion Invasions.

Protector Gariel is a human guard at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. Along with other guards, she will fight the gnolls occasionally though not doing any real damage. She was previously part of the People's Militia. She was present during the Legion Invasions.

Protector Korelor is a human guard patrolling the road between Sentinel Hill and Molsen Farm in Westfall. He is affiliated with the Westfall Brigade. He was previously part of the People's Militia. He was present during the Legion Invasions.

Protector Bialon is a human guard in Sentinel Hill. Before the Cataclysm, he used to guard the Defias Traitor. Along with other guards, he will fight the gnolls occasionally though not doing any real damage. He was previously part of the People's Militia. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Prophet Hadassi was the wisest and eldest member of the Orsis tribe. He died after Al'akir's attack.

Prospector Torgan is a dwarf located at Dun Argol in Grizzly Hills. At the time of the war against the Lich King, along with Explorers' League prospectors Varana and Varana, Torgan was sent to Dun Argol by Raegar Breakbrow to search for artifacts and information about the history of the settlement. However, they never expected Dun Argol to be this heavily populated and they were all taken captive by the iron dwarves. They were later rescued by adventurers.

Prospector Varana is a dwarf located at Dun Argol in Grizzly Hills. At the time of the war against the Lich King, along with Explorers' League prospectors Gann and Torgan, Varana was sent to Dun Argol by Raegar Breakbrow to search for artifacts and information about the history of the settlement. However, they never expected Dun Argol to be this heavily populated and they were all taken captive by the iron dwarves. They were later rescued by adventurers. According to Muradin Bronzebeard, Varana kept a cool head and was the on who brought them back the news that the iron dwarves were serving the mad Keeper Loken.

Prospector Khrona was a dwarf who went on an expedition with Brann Bronzebeard to find Norgannon's Core. They set up camp at Brann's Base-Camp and Khrona started to take notes. Unfortunately, a group of iron dwarves attacked and killed all inhabitants.

Prospector Soren was a dwarf who went on an expedition with Brann Bronzebeard to find Norgannon's Core. They set up camp at Brann's Base-Camp and Soren started to draw maps. Unfortunately, a group of iron dwarves attacked and killed all inhabitants.
Professor Augustine is a human located in the Whale's Belly in Tiragarde Sound.

Professor Elryna is a night elf teacher who was killed by General Huxzar when she showed him her research on creation of snapdragons. Collector Kojo and an adventurer found her work and fate through visions in Nar'anan in Nazjatar.

Prophet Nox'tir is a nerubian vizier located at in the Skittering Hollow, he is a member of a group of living nerubians known as Voru'kar. When attacked, he claims that the attackers will never find the Voru'kar's hidden cache of eggs and that their swarm is eternal.
Professor Mystakria is a green dragon located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Professor Intinosa is a blue dragon located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus. She is being assisted by an Academy Attendant. Later, she came to Azure Archives along with other blue dragons.
Prospector Gurt is a Mag'har orc mining trainer located in Camp Antonidas in the Azure Span.
Professor Oxigos is a blue dragon located in Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Professor Bilmorus is a green dragon located in Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus. He is lecturing to Algeth'ar students.
Professor Dyanstrasz is a red dragon in blood elf visage located in Thaldraszus.
Professor Ichistrasz is a red dragon located in the Botanica in Algeth'ar Academy.

Prospector Arty is a human located at the Crystal Shore in the Cape of Stranglethorn. He hired Hired Bodyguards and inspects the Venture Co. oil rigs. Captain Grub Redcut paid Arty to devalue Zeros' crystals in the auction house, so he was the anonymous contributor to the BBJ's front page. This caused Zeros problems with Baron Revilgaz, so the blue dragon, aided by an adventurer, asked Blixrez Goodstitch to reveal who the anonymous contributor to the newspaper was. After helping him, Blixrez told them it was Arty, and Zeros had the adventurer bribe Arty's bodyguards, so that he could learn who was behind this betrayal. Arty noticed his bodyguards gone and revealed it was Grub Redcut.
Provisioner Braknar is a Mag'har orc located at Mag'har Post in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Provisioner Tsaalt is a Broken general goods, reagent, food and drink vendor located at the entrance to the Shadow Labyrinth in Terokkar Forest.

Protector Leick is a human guard at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. He stands near the Lumbermill at the bottom end of the hill. He was previously part of the People's Militia. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Protector Weaver is a human guard located on the top of Sentinel Tower in Westfall. He was previously part of the People's Militia. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Psychic Horror is a Shadow priest talent that instantly stuns a target for 4 seconds. It is an exclusive choice node with Last Word (priest talent).
Provisioner Lorkran is an orc general goods vendor located in Grizzly Hills.
Provisioner Tria is a night elf general goods vendor located at Shadebough in Feralas.

Provisioner Angelus is a level 15 general goods vendor at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas during the phasing of that area as part of the Silverpine Forest storyline. It is unclear what becomes of him following the retreat from this area.
Psyfiend is a Shadow priest PvP talent, available at level 40. It summons a Psyfiend beside the player with a 12-second duration, attacking an enemy with Psyflay.
Provisioner Graka is an orc located at the Glopgut's Hollow in the Twilight Highlands. She sells various goods.
Provisioner Drog is an orc vendor found in the Forlorn Hut on the Wandering Isle.
Provisioner Phelps is a human vendor found at the Wreck of the Skyseeker on the Wandering Isle.
Provisioner Zukama is an orc vendor located Vol'mar, the main Horde base in Tanaan Jungle.
Provisioner Stapleton is a human located at the Timbered Strand in Drustvar.
Provisioner Qorra is a human located in Ramkahen in Uldum. She can be found at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus as the vendor for Azq'roth items.
Provisioner Thom is a human located in the Obsidian Enclave in Valdrakken.
Purkom is an orc Warsong Offensive PvP rewards vendor located in Venture Bay in the Grizzly Hills.
Punchio is a goblin monk sitting atop a rock in the lake in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom. Players can pay him to receive pieces of "sage advice".
Qiraji Brigadier General Pax-lish is a qiraji located in the Silithus desert, though he may also appear in Feralas or Tanaris. He spawns only during the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj event.

Pyromancer Scorchbrew is a Dark Iron dwarf mage trainer located in the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge. He is one of the Dark Iron dwarves that stayed with Moira Thaurissan after her reunion with the dwarves of Ironforge. He is standing with Lainda Gemgold and Flarna Flametongue, talking with them.
Pyromancer Flamehearth is a Dark Iron dwarf located at the Shimmer Ridge in Dun Morogh during the Blood in the Snow scenario.
Archie Wandswaddle is a dwarf found at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Pyrecaster Zindra is an orc located north of the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands.
Pyretic Incantation is a Fire mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Fire at Will trait.
Pyroclasmic Paranoia is a Fire mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Cauterizing Blink (artifact trait), Fire at Will and Burning Gaze traits.

Quartermaster Miranda Breechlock is a dwarf Argent Crusade reputation goods vendor (only with and above), located at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. At some point, after World of Warcraft and before Cataclysm, she lost her right eye.

Quartermaster Zigris is an elite orc mini-boss found in Blackrock Spire. He can be found up the ramp, in the opposite direction of the hall that leads to Halycon. He always drops 5 Major Healing Potions and 5 Major Mana Potions, he sometimes has the plans for Annihilator, and in his room there is occasionally a chest. Other than sometimes only having the potions and a few coins, he has one notable drop: the Worg Pup companion, which is a guaranteed drop. So while optional, he can be worth the time.
Quarrymaster Thesten is a dwarf of the Miners' League located in Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh. During Legion Invasions, he led the defense of the Quarry.

Quartermaster Hicks is a human weapons vendor located at the Westbrook Garrison in Elwynn Forest. He can be found in the keep, in a room to the right of the entrance, beside Quartermaster Hudson and Veldan Lightfoot.

Quartermaster Hudson is a human armor and shield vendor located at the Westbrook Garrison in Elwynn Forest. He can be found in the barracks, in a room to the right of the entrance, beside Quartermaster Hicks and Veldan Lightfoot.
Quartermaster Lewis is a human general goods vendor located in Sentinel Tower in Westfall. Lewis appears inside the entrance to the Deadmines as well. He was present during the Legion Invasions.

Quartermaster Davian Vaclav is a human PvP rewards vendor located in Halaa in Nagrand. He sells items in exchange for Halaa Research Tokens and Halaa Battle Tokens. These tokens are obtained from fighting mobs and enemy players near Halaa. He is only available when the Alliance controls Halaa.
Quartermaster Lymel is a Forsaken general goods vendor located at Tranquillien in the Ghostlands.
Quartermaster Gorman is a human bread and drink vendor located at the Stair of Destiny in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Quartermaster Drake is a human general goods vendor located at the Stair of Destiny in the Hellfire Peninsula.

Quellan Maisara is a Quel'dorei sorcerer. He was one of the member's of Aron Kodosbreath's expedition to Stranglethorn Vale. Two days into the expedition he was kidnapped, and wasn't found until the nineteenth day of the expedition, when he gave warnings to Aron.
Quartermaster Holgoth is an orc located at the Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra.
Quartermaster Gakzug is a Mag'har orc quartermaster living in Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight.
Quartermaster McCarty is a human innkeeper found in Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.
Quartermaster Lawson is a general goods vendor found at Honor's Stand in the Southern Barrens. During the Fourth War, he was encountered by the Horde champions who laid siege to Honor's Stand.
Quartermaster Rallings is a human general goods vendor located at Darkbreak Cove in the Abyssal Depths.
Quel'dorei Spirit is a ghost of a high elf at Lake Kel'theril in central Winterspring. He is one of three spirits that are visited to figure out the curse of Zin-Malor. The other two are a and a .
Quartermaster Rutherford is a human general goods vendor located in Northwatch Hold in the Southern Barrens. It is unknown whether he survived the Razing of Northwatch Hold or not.

Quartermaster Dekrok is an orc general goods vendor found at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands. He's quite peculiar, having the red skin of a fel orc, a look shared by some Horde Portal-Sentries. It's unclear if this means that they are fel orcs who have joined the New Horde or if their appearance is a developer mistake. It's unknown if he survived the Ironmarch.

Quartermaster Kaoshin is an orc quartermaster of the Blackrock Clan located in the Burning Steppes. He gives orders to the grunts, and is under General Thorg'izog's command. It's unknown what happened to him after the fall of the Blackrock orcs in the area.

Quartermaster Apone is a human general goods vendor located at the Alliance camp near the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands. It's unknown if he survived the Iron Horde's invasion into Azeroth, as he does not appear during the post-invasion phase of Blasted Lands. To find him on a character above level 90, ask Zidormi about Blasted Lands before the invasion.
Quartermaster Dernhak is an orc general goods vendor located at the Desolation Hold in the Southern Barrens.

Quartermaster Higgins is a dwarf general goods vendor found at Fort Triumph in the Southern Barrens. His status after the fall of Fort Triumph just prior to the destruction of Theramore Isle is unknown.

Quartermaster Winfred is a human general goods vendor found at Forward Command in the Southern Barrens. His status after the fall of Northwatch Hold and Fort Triumph just prior to the destruction of Theramore Isle is unknown.
Quartermaster Jolie is a human located at Southport‎ in Spires of Arak.
Quartermaster Talastis is an undead night elf located at Ravencourt in Val'sharah.
Queen Kraklaa was the queen of the makrura in Azsuna who was being controlled by Oublion the Jailer.

Queen Carnassa is a devilsaur queen who rules over a large brood of raptors in Un'Goro Crater in the Journey to Un'Goro expansion for Hearthstone. She is summoned when a hunter completes the quest "The Marsh Queen".

Quartermaster Rowley is a dwarven member of the "Bloodsail Boomers" who appears at the Bloodsail Buccaneers' beach party on the Cape of Stranglethorn's Wild Shore during Pirates' Day. He will occasionally burst into song alongside the other Bloodsail Boomers - Cook Lastwind, First Mate Nereus, and Gunner Pops.
Quartermaster Killian is a human located in Plunder Harbor in Tiragarde Sound. He acts as a vendor who sells crafting reagents and more.
Quartermaster Alcorn is a human located in Arom's Stand in Drustvar.
Quartermaster Gaines is a human crewman of The Relentless, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Boralus.

Wasi is a former queen of the Zandalari Empire. Her remains are buried within Kings' Rest in Atal'Dazar. Her mummified corpse is raised by Zul and is fought by adventurers. The time of her rule is unknown.

Patlaa is a former queen of the Zandalari Empire. Her remains are buried within Kings' Rest in Atal'Dazar. Her mummified corpse is raised by Zul and is fought by adventurers. The time of her rule is unknown.
Quartermaster Rauka is an orc located at the Port of Zandalar in Dazar'alor.

Quartermaster Peregrin is an Alliance officer stationed in the Kul Tiran capital of Boralus. There, he helps to oversee the war effort against the Horde on various warfronts as part of the Fourth War. Peregrin is specifically responsible for the collection and organization of war resources.
Quartermaster Rickard is a human innkeeper and vendor located in Watchman's Tower in Drustvar.
Queligosa was a blue dragon who died after somehow piercing a dimensional boundary. Her name is on a Fresh Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Quickness is a passive night elf racial trait. It slightly increases movement speed as well as the chance to dodge Melee and Ranged attacks by 2% at all times.

Quin'thalan Sunfire is a blood elf paladin featured in DC Unlimited's World of Warcraft: Series 3 action figure set. Though a paladin, his equipment resembles that of a spellbreaker. He has not yet appeared in any other media.

Quetz'lun's Spirit is the spirit of the Drakkari wind serpent loa. She was betrayed by her prophet, but brought her Drakkari worshippers into a "special underworld of her own creation" before her physical manifestation was slain. She says that she can at least "delight in their eternal torment". She will assist players in killing her prophet in the quest You Reap What You Sow.
Ra'wiri is a Zandalari troll general goods vendor found at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.
Quid is a water spirit located in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. During N'Zoth's assault, Quid has been corrupted.

Ra'nok was an orc who participated in raids against draenei on Draenor. J'argg Bloodfyre ordered him to burn a draenei dead body and to have a camp set up near a cave where Alius was hiding. After the betrayal of Jaruk, Ra'nok served J'argg as a tracker and tracked Jaruk's footprints. Years later, he remained with J'argg and tracked Leena and her cub Pebbles. He was eventually killed by Jaruk.
Qwilla Bloodedge is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Quick Sip is a Brewmaster monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Stave Off trait.
Quilius is a green dragon located at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus.
Raena Flinthammer is a dwarf light armor vendor located in the Commons in Ironforge.
Radnaal Maneweaver is a night elf artisan skinning trainer located northwest of the Ban'ethil Hollow in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Radulf Leder is a human Arathi Basin battlemaster located at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands.
Kravel Koalbeard is a dwarf located at the Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles. He was formerly located at the Mirage Raceway.
Raging Blow is a tier 2 Fury warrior talent. It deals weapon damage with both weapons instantly, similar to Stormstrike or Mutilate.

Rada'jin was a Darkspear troll druid and member of the Garad'kra. He wanted to ease the tensions between the Darkspear and the rest of the Horde by proving that the trolls were strong and worthy allies, no matter the cost.

Raedra Windhammer is a Wildhammer dwarf shaman trainer found drinking at the bar of Theramore Isle's inn in Dustwallow Marsh. It's stated by guards that she's there to visit an old friend, who may be Bartender Lillian. It's unknown if she survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.

Raa'la is an orc who didn't make it out of the beta. She was located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge and was involved in a quest called A Gift for Raa'la. In it, her father Rakla wanted to give Raa'la a Baby Rylak (item) after taking out its presumed mother.
Raevyn Sorrowblade is a Darkfallen death knight located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Rag'sla Thunkblade is a Burning Blade orc that attacks the garrison in order to retrieve the Heart of Gorgorek.
Rage Machine was a warrior honor talent, available at rank 6.
Ragash Bloodwish is an orc located at the Mist's Edge in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns.
Rachael Vaccar is a human located in Nethergarde Keep in Blasted Lands.
Rabid Hillstalker is a spirit wolf located in Nazjatar during The Fate of Professor Elryna.
Raamsheld is a dwarf walking just south of Ironforge in Dun Morogh.
Rakoria is an orc found at Stonebreaker Hold in Terokkar Forest. She was interested in creating olemba oil.
Raj Naz'jan was the emperor of Riplash when Leviroth was imprisoned. Queen Azshara herself blessed his trident so it would slay the beast should it ever escape.

Raider Kerr is an orc found patrolling between the Valley of Trials and Razor Hill in Durotar. He travels alongside Raider Jhash. He is not actively found in Durotar in Cataclysm. He does, however, appear as an escort for new players, during the quest Riding On, to Razor Hill. Kerr and Jhash were present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill.

Raider Jhash is an orc found patrolling between the Valley of Trials and Razor Hill in Durotar. He travels alongside Raider Kerr. Since the Cataclysm, he is stationed at Sen'jin Village and provides the adventurer with a mount and escort, Raider Kerr, for the quest Riding On. Jhash and Kerr were present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill.
Ral'jin is a forest troll witch doctor. He is trying to gather enough sacrifices to summon Ula-Tek.

Rak'gor Bloodrazor is an elite orc who accompanied Garrosh Hellscream to Pandaria as his bodyguard. Garrosh then ordered Rak'gor to go with Vol'jin to investigate the saurok rookery in the Dagger in the Dark scenario. He was followed by two Kor'kron Bodyguards. It is revealed in the end that he is actually an assassin, rather than a scout leader, and was dispatched by Garrosh Hellscream to put an end to Vol'jin's dissension permanently, if he proves himself a traitor by disagreeing. Throughout the ambush, he questions the adventurers' loyalties, but with the aid of Vol'jin's totems, the heroes were able to defeat the duplicitous orc.

Rakalaz was a legendary creature encountered one hundred years ago in a kaja'mite mine within the Undermine on Kezan. Trade Prince Leeko was sending kaja'miners deeper than anyone had been before. Miners dug too deep and a miner named Miz broke through what he thought was a rock wall and found "a void." Inside of this void was Rakalaz. Rakalaz and Miz died when Miz used his last stick of dynamite to blow up the creature.
Rala Wildheart is an orc found in Warspear on Ashran. She is located by the tauren quarter's central fire, where she is engaged in conversation with Shadow Hunter Askia.
Raindash is a faerie dragon located at the Embaari Village in .
Rail Commander Lokkar was an orc located on a train in Gorgrond and was taken out by the followers sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
Allison Weber is a human fish and meat vendor located at Boralus Harbor in Boralus.
Raider Zugg is an orc located in Newstead in Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Rakla is an orc who did not make it out of the beta. He would be located in Frostfire Ridge and would ask to collect a baby rylak from Windswept Lowlands for his daughter Raa'la.
Raize Shadespear is a night elf located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players.
Ralia Dreamchaser is a night elf druid located in Exile's Reach.
Randal Worth is a human located in Old Town in Stormwind. He resides in a store called the Protective Hide. According to Simon Tanner, he is a bit of a dandy but dependable.

Randal Hunter is a human horse riding trainer located in the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. He is notable for teaching novice adventurers and others the basics of riding horses. He can be found at the stables in the northern part of the camp near Katie Hunter.
Rann Flamespinner is a dwarf tailoring vendor located in Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

Ran Tilwood was a young human male. He was a student of Logan Palimore in training as a Caretaker. Logan Palimore had misjudged Ran's character as he turned out to be a thief. Ran attempted to rob the artifacts he was supposed to be guarding in Stormwind. Logan banned him from the Caretakers, and used some contacts he had in the Stormwind Assassins to take care of the young man.

Ranisa Whitebough is a night elf Pilgrim's Bounty Vendor available during the Pilgrim's Bounty event. She is located in the Exodar at the Pilgrim's Bounty feast tables and is dressed in what looks like a traditional Native American outfit.
Ramox was a human, and member of group of adventurers who were tricked by Oakwidow into assaulting a mine guarded by ancients. He claimed to have fought at the fall of Dalaran.
Randolph Moloch is an elite human found in Stormwind Stockade. Moloch starts the fight with a bow, then starts swinging.
Ranadae is a night elf located at the Wetlands farm in the Wetlands who sits next to Kartanus.

Ralton is an orc found at Grol'dom Farm in the Northern Barrens. From atop the roof of his burning home, he fends off the torch-bearing Razormane Pillagers by hurling axes (and verbal abuse). During the Legion Invasions, he was injured but rescued by the adventurers. Demons killed his livestock.
Ramah Goldenray is a blood elf vendor located at Bloodwatcher Point in the Badlands.

Ranger Orestes is a blood elf Farstrider who accompanied Lor'themar Theron to the Valley of the Emperors. He and Blood Knight Aenea are tasked by the regent lord to fight their way through the valley and capture a mogu warlord for questioning. He and Aenea do not appear to be the closest of friends.

Randal was a human entrusted with guarding the Dark Portal after its destruction. One night Randal and his comrade Willam were taken by surprise when the Dark Portal reopened and a dark shadow covered the area. Randal ordered Willam to sound the alarm while he decided to investigate his foggy surroundings and heard unknown footsteps. He ordered the being to stop, but they got even closer. While he had no idea were they came from, he felt one behind him and held up his shield. The unknown figure was indeed strong for he crushed the shield and the impact ripped off Randal's arm. All guards guarding the Dark Portal were eventually killed when the Horde and death knight took it over.
Ranger Shalan is a blood elf stable master found aboard the Crimson Treader and Dawnseeker Promontory on the Isle of Thunder.

Rangari Kaalya is a draenei Marksmanship hunter native to Draenor who helped the champion address the threat of the Botani in southern Gorgrond. Soon after meeting Yrel, she flatly judged that the 'temple-kneeler' had no business being in Gorgrond (and possibly as being naïve) which quickly got on Yrel's nerves. After having fought at Karabor, Yrel believes she can handle the jungle. All this causes a mutual dislike between the two. She can also be seen watching fights between garrison commanders in the Coliseum of Highmaul.

Ramall Trueoak is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, he appears in Stormwind Harbor at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.
Randal Pine is a human located at the Lunarfall's Lumber Mill in .

Rantuko Grimtouch is a tauren death knight of the Knights of the Ebon Blade found in front of the portal to Niskara on Darkstone Isle off the Broken Shore. During The Dead and the Damned, he informs the death knight adventurer that the knights have secured the Azerothian side of the portal. During Report to Oribos, he was seen leading a group of knights, guarding the Ring of Fates in Oribos.
